meta.title: 自由泳划手常见的错误动作纠正

scenes.context: 教练观察学员划手，发现肩膀位置需要调整。先诊断，再纠正。语域：游泳教学，动作纠正。
sentences: The coach watches the student's pull.
scenes.speak: The coach watches the student's pull. The shoulder position needs adjusting. Diagnose first, then correct.

scenes.context: 教练用触觉引导：按压肩部，引导划手发力起点。用手感替代口述。语域：游泳教学，触觉纠正。
sentences: 按压肩部，找到发力起点。
Press the shoulder to find where the power starts.
where the power starts（发力起点）
feel replaces cues（手感替代口述）
paraphrase: 发力起点 → the power start / point of initiation
scenes.speak: The coach uses tactile guidance. Press the shoulder to find where the power starts. Feel replaces verbal cues.

scenes.context: 肩带臂完成高肘抱水：手掌与前臂有效抓水。以肩为轴，而不是以肘为轴。语域：游泳教学，动作要领。
sentences: The shoulder leads the arm into the high-elbow catch.
Palm and forearm grip the water effectively.
Pivot from the shoulder, not the elbow.
pivot from the shoulder（以肩为轴）
paraphrase: 高肘抱水 → high-elbow catch / elbow-up pull
以肩为轴 → pivot from the shoulder / shoulder-driven
scenes.speak: The shoulder leads the arm into the high-elbow catch. Palm and forearm grip the water effectively. Pivot from the shoulder, not the elbow.

practice: Palm and forearm grip the water effectively.
pitfalls: Pivot from the shoulder, not the elbow.
「以肩为轴」用 pivot from the shoulder。
The shoulder leads the arm into the high-elbow catch.
「肩带臂」是 shoulder leads the arm。
「触觉引导」用 tactile guidance，手感替代口述。
shifts: 用 freestyle pull（自由泳划手）、high-elbow catch（高肘抱水）、grip the water（抓水）
用 diagnose first（先诊断）、tactile guidance（触觉引导）、needs adjusting（需要调整）
用 where the power starts（发力起点）、pivot from the shoulder（以肩为轴）、initiation（启动）
footer_notes: 本视频无口播转录，场景数据基于图文实录图片说明（figcaption）重建。已校正：观察划手、肩膀位置需要调整、按压肩部引导发力起点、肩带臂完成高肘抱水、手掌与前臂有效抓水、以肩为轴等。
